items.title: Kristen Korb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000
items.q: I was there a year ago and I got lessons with Ron Carter and Rufus Reid

ctx.x: Yeah, there’s an energy there for sure.

Oh yeah. I learn so much. But at the same time I don’t want to move into that community and have to be dependent on it for my livelihood. Because I know that it’s not going to pay in that way. You’d have to get out of town and I don’t want to move there not really knowing too many people. So what I’m trying to do right now is make visits at least once a year. I’d like to up it to twice a year, and just hang for a week or more each time, and meet the musicians. I was there a year ago and I got lessons with Ron…
I know. I wish I could put it in words, what that is.
